candidates.title: [ux-sim] "Get in" goes straight into a 7-screen sign-up with no look around first; interests are asked twice
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

All four first-open personas noted "Get in" jumps into sign-up with a 7-dash progress bar. The how-Lumi-helps screen read as a wall of English text; the second interest picker repeated the first. Jordan quit on the how-Lumi-helps screen without signing up.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence high · **4 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The new onboarding (merged 2026-11-03) kept all earlier screens around the mockup's four steps, so it is still 7 screens before any content, with two overlapping interest pickers and a text-only explainer.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide` step 9 — “ok and? I picked clubs and you show me a wall of text about clubs. 4 more dashes to go. boring.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/009-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/009-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide` step 2 — “wait I didn't even get to look around. 7 steps?? ugh.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/002-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/shots/002-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide` step 25 — “Didn't I just answer this? I already said clubs and meeting people. This is the fifth screen and I still haven't seen a single club.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/025-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/025-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide` step 16 — “아 귀찮아... another picker. still haven't seen a single person or the app itself” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/016-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/016-click-som.jpg)
- run `sched-20261103-1915-seoyeon-first-open-decide` step 17 — “또 질문... 이메일은 언제 해? 그냥 Skip 할래.” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-seoyeon-first-open-decide/shots/017-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-seoyeon-first-open-decide/shots/017-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-jordan-first-open-decide/report.md), [`sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/report.md), [`sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide/report.md), [`sched-20261103-1915-seoyeon-first-open-decide`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-seoyeon-first-open-decide/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `jordan-sophomore-impatient`, `minji-freshman-17`, `aisha-firstgen-anxious`, `seoyeon-exchange-korean` · scenarios: `first-open-decide`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Let people browse before sign-up (or after name + school only); merge "What would you like to discover?" into "What brings you"; shorten the how-Lumi-helps cards to one line each.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Sign-up says birth year is "never shown on your profile", but profiles show age and the privacy policy says so
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Aisha read the Privacy Policy ("your age shows on your profile") then the sign-up hint "Only to check you’re 16+. Never shown on your profile." The app does show age next to the name on Home and person pages.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

The hint was added in the 2026-11-03 onboarding change (claude/onboarding-4step) without checking the profile pages; it is factually wrong.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide` step 7 — “Also the privacy page I just read said my age sho…” _(Verified in code: PersonPage/HomePage render current year − birthYear + 1 next to the name.)_ [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/007-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-aisha-first-open-decide/shots/007-click-som.jpg)

Personas: `aisha-firstgen-anxious` · scenarios: `first-open-decide`

Change the hint to "Used to check you’re 16+. Your age shows on your profile." (or stop showing age) — one-line copy fix in StartPage.

candidates.title: [ux-sim] Welcome teasers and first "For you" cards are grad/career items for undergrads
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Three undergrads saw grad-oriented teaser cards on /welcome; after picking clubs / meet people, Home "For you" led with a Grad Student Appreciation Party or a law careers panel.

Severity **3** (Major — real confusion, a wrong path or many extra steps; I nearly gave up or only got through by guessing.) · analyst confidence medium · **3 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Teaser and For-you ranking ignore the role (undergrad) and the goals just picked; recent live events happen to be grad/career-heavy.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide` step 30 — “뭐지... where's the lunch thing I saw at the start? 'For you' = grad student party?? I'm 17 lol. not for me” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/030-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261103-1915-minji-first-open-decide/shots/030-click-som.jpg)
